mapper.select: select c.id, c.buyer_id as buyerId, c.seller_id as sellerId, c.product_id as productId, c.last_message as lastMessage, c.last_msg_time as lastMsgTime, case when c.buyer_id = #{userId} then c.buyer_unread else c.seller_unread end as unread, case when c.buyer_id = #{userId} then c.seller_id else c.buyer_id end as otherUserId, case when c.buyer_id = #{userId} then coalesce(sp.nickname, su2.nick_name) else coalesce(bp.nickname, su1.nick_name) end as otherNickname, case when c.buyer_id = #{userId} then sp.avatar else bp.avatar end as otherAvatar, p.title as productTitle, (select pi.url from sm_product_image pi where pi.product_id = p.id order by pi.sort limit 1) as productImage, p.price as productPrice from sm_chat_conversation c left join sm_product p on c.product_id = p.id left join sm_user_profile bp on c.buyer_id = bp.user_id left join sm_user_profile sp on c.seller_id = sp.user_id left join sys_user su1 on c.buyer_id = su1.user_id left join sys_user su2 on c.seller_id = su2.user_id where (c.buyer_id = #{userId} or c.seller_id = #{userId}) and c.status = '0' order by c.last_msg_time desc nulls last
select seller_id from sm_product where id = #{productId} and del_flag = '0'
